You dip your head in a courteous greeting, then bring your hidden blade up beneath your opponent’s guard.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Hide your intent in an ordinary gesture, then make a melee attack. If you began Hidden, gain 1 Boon to this attack and end Hidden normally.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage and Slowed 1.
Strong
5 physical damage and Slowed 2.
